# VisionOps

> VisionOps is a Kubernetes and DevOps consulting company based in the Czech Republic. We specialize in production Kubernetes cluster implementation, OpenShift administration, cloud migration, CI/CD automation, and infrastructure monitoring. We serve businesses looking for container orchestration expertise, both on-premises and in the cloud.

- Website: [https://visionops.cz](https://visionops.cz)
- Full content: [https://visionops.cz/llms-full.txt](https://visionops.cz/llms-full.txt)
- Contact: info@visionops.cz
- Languages: Czech, English

## Services

- [OpenShift & Kubernetes Consulting](https://visionops.cz/sluzby/openshift-konzultace/): Production Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes clusters on-prem (bare metal, Proxmox) and in the cloud. Architecture, installation, GitOps with ArgoCD, CI/CD, security hardening, observability.
- [Proxmox VE & VMware Migration](https://visionops.cz/sluzby/proxmox-virtualizace/): Proxmox VE clusters with Ceph and Proxmox Backup Server, migration from VMware vSphere with minimal downtime, Proxmox as a foundation for OpenShift/Kubernetes.
- [CI/CD Automation & GitOps](https://visionops.cz/sluzby/cicd-gitops/): Automated pipelines from commit to production. ArgoCD, GitLab CI, Tekton, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code, canary deployments, supply chain security.
- [Monitoring & Observability](https://visionops.cz/sluzby/monitoring-observability/): Metrics, logs and traces with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Grafana Beyla (eBPF) and Zabbix.

## Technology Stack

- Platforms: Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS, Proxmox VE
- CI/CD: ArgoCD, Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions
- Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Beyla, Zabbix, Jaeger
- IaC & Security: Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Vault, Trivy

## Engagement Process

1. Assessment — thorough analysis of current infrastructure state
2. Solution design — custom architecture tailored to your needs
3. Implementation — Infrastructure as Code, automation, best practices
4. Knowledge transfer — training, documentation, complete handoff
5. Ongoing support — consulting available after go-live

## Case Studies

- [Zentity: OpenShift on Proxmox](https://visionops.cz/reference/zentity-openshift-proxmox/): Proxmox VE cluster with PBS, production OpenShift 4.x, ArgoCD GitOps, GitLab CE, Ansible provisioning and an OpenTelemetry observability stack
